agent_priors_used: Long-horizon agents compound planning errors and path-dependence: early branch choices determine observability, so inheritance must be gated by verifiable intermediate checkpoints and calibrated UNKNOWN abstention, not end-to-end success alone — prior used to prioritize verification AUROC/UNKNOWN precision over raw success

Retrieval without calibrated abstention dominates economics via false_accept: a single wrong inheritance costs more than cold re-exploration (contamination, security) — prior used to require UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 and ECE <=0.15 as economic gates for parameterized inheritance

Tool/API bypass beats trajectory replay when structured affordances exist (WebMCP, XPaths, endpoints); DOM replay is brittle under drift — prior used to pivot frontier from URL-path aliasing to WebMCP tool-aliasing and to require header/body/auth parameterization

Memory write exploitation/exploration tradeoff: indiscriminate accumulation pollutes retrieval and increases staleness; amortization requires freshness/invalidation with provenance — prior used to park C-DELTA-REPAIR and C-CROSSSITE exhaustive search until invalidation substrate is valid

Exploration basins are locally attractive: repeated estimator tuning (61 web-dynamics, 43 C-MEAS-VALID consecutive) can produce tunnel_flag true while real gap remains synthetic-to-real, requiring forced orthogonal falsifiable programs (timescale separation, barrier/committor) — prior used to pivot physics off plug-in CMI loops
